steps.title: Coat plates with PO‑L and prepare NP medium
steps.instruction: Prepare poly‑L‑ornithine (PO) and laminin coated plates and make neural precursor (NP) culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Coat culture plates or flasks with 100 µg/mL poly‑L‑ornithine in DPBS; incubate 2 h at 37 °C.
Remove poly‑L‑ornithine solution and wash plates three times with DPBS.
Add laminin diluted in DPBS to achieve 1–2 µg/cm²; incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Optional: for initial NP establishment, seed cells in a 6‑well plate before scaling up.
Prepare 500 mL NP culture medium lacking EGF and FGF‑2.
Just before use, supplement the NP medium with fresh growth factors in small aliquots (e.g., 40 mL) to ensure activity.

steps.title: Perform CytoTox‑Glo cytotoxicity assay
steps.instruction: Measure basal and total‑cell cytotoxicity of hESC‑derived neurons using the Promega CytoTox‑Glo kit.

substeps.instruction: a. Basal cytotoxicity (first reading):
i. Prepare AAF‑Glo Assay Reagent by mixing 5 mL assay buffer with the AAF‑Glo substrate powder supplied in the kit.
ii. Gently aspirate old neuronal differentiation medium from each well of a 96‑well PO‑L coated plate.
iii. Add 100 µL fresh neuronal differentiation medium to each well, avoiding harsh pipetting that could detach the neuronal network.
iv. Add 50 µL AAF‑Glo solution to each well and pipette up‑and‑down twice to mix.
v. Cover the plate with foil and incubate 15 min at room temperature.
vi. Measure luminescence with a microplate reader; record two readings and average them (basal cytotoxicity).
b. Induced cytotoxicity (second reading – total cells):
i. Prepare Lysis Reagent by mixing 5 mL assay buffer with 33 µL digitonin.
ii. Add 50 µL Lysis Reagent to each well of the same plate and pipette up‑and‑down twice to mix.
iii. Cover with foil and incubate 15 min at room temperature.
iv. Measure luminescence at 15 min, 30 min, and 60 min after lysis (keep plate covered with foil between readings).
c. Data normalization:
i. Use the luminescence value from a single steady‑state time point (e.g., 30 min) as the total‑cell signal.
ii. Divide the basal cytotoxicity value (first reading) by the total‑cell signal (second reading) to obtain normalized cytotoxicity.
iii. Express the result as a percentage.

steps.title: Label neurons with TUNEL assay
steps.instruction: Detect fragmented DNA in apoptotic neurons using the Click‑iT Plus TUNEL kit (Invitrogen).

substeps.instruction: a. Prepare all kit solutions according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
b. Remove media from each well of a 24‑well plate containing coverslips and wash once with 200 µL DPBS (no shaking).
c. Fix cells with 200 µL 4 % paraformaldehyde per well for 15 min at room temperature on a flat surface (no shaking).
d. Remove PFA and permeabilize with 200 µL 0.25 % Triton X‑100 in DPBS per well; incubate 20 min at room temperature (flat, no shaking).
e. Wash each coverslip gently twice with 200 µL deionized water (DNase/RNase‑free) for 5 min each at room temperature (no shaking).
f. Incubate coverslips with 100 µL TdT Reaction Buffer per well for 10 min at 37 °C in a humidified incubator.
g. Prepare TdT reaction mixture as instructed; add 50 µL to each coverslip and incubate 60 min at 37 °C in a humidified incubator.
h. Wash coverslips gently twice with 200 µL 3 % BSA in DPBS for 5 min each at room temperature (no shaking).
i. Prepare fresh TUNEL Reaction Buffer Additive and TUNEL reaction cocktail according to the kit.
j. Add 50 µL TUNEL reaction cocktail to each coverslip, cover the plate with foil, and incubate 30 min at 37 °C in a humidified incubator.
k. Wash coverslips gently twice with 200 µL 3 % BSA in DPBS for 5 min each at room temperature (no shaking).
l. Keep the plate protected from light (foil) after the TUNEL step.

steps.title: Immunostain neurons for TUJ1
steps.instruction: Label neuronal cells with TUJ1 primary antibody and Alexa Fluor 594 secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: a. Block each coverslip with 300 µL 3 % BSA in DPBS for 1 h at room temperature; keep plate covered with foil.
b. Add 200 µL TUJ1 antibody diluted 1:200 in 3 % BSA/DPBS to each coverslip; incubate overnight at 4 °C, plate covered with foil (no rocking).
c. Wash coverslips gently twice with 200 µL DPBS for 5 min each at room temperature (foil covered).
d. Add 200 µL Alexa Fluor 594 secondary antibody diluted 1:1000 in 3 % BSA/DPBS; incubate 1 h at room temperature, plate covered with foil.
e. Wash coverslips gently twice with 200 µL DPBS for 5 min each at room temperature (foil covered).
f. Mount each coverslip onto a glass slide using ProLong Gold antifade reagent with DAPI; incubate 15–30 min at room temperature in the dark.
g. Seal coverslips to slides with nail varnish, taking care not to move the coverslips.

steps.title: Image and quantify TUNEL+ neurons
steps.instruction: Acquire fluorescence images and calculate the percentage of apoptotic (TUNEL+) neurons among TUJ1+ cells.

substeps.instruction: a. Image each coverslip using fluorescence microscopy: capture green signal (TUNEL) and red signal (TUJ1).
b. For each sample, analyze at least 200 TUJ1+ cells.
c. Count TUNEL+ nuclei within the TUJ1+ population.
d. Calculate % TUNEL+ = (number of TUNEL+ nuclei ÷ total TUJ1+ cells) × 100.
e. Store sealed slides at 4 °C; complete imaging and analysis within one week to avoid fluorescence fading.
